items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Fess was there when we went there with Arthur Gibbs.

ctx.x: So you came in after that.

After that. Well, Fess was there when we went there with Arthur Gibbs. (cause) (unintelligible) Chick we were the two house bands, they'd bring 2nd from Arthur Gibbs. (unintelligible) Then we played in bands like there come in town, 25 added attractions, you know, you bring in the band. Then Fess came in with his Savoy band, and he had ten pieces. We only had nine, but that was all right. We didn't pay that no mind. We just had the right
way to do it, and people liked us, and Cecil Scott brought a group in there.
